name: Direct KiCad sources
sourceContract: Generate exactly one complete KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) and matching schematic (.kicad_sch), with referenced libraries/footprints available in the installed image. Do not emit atopile sources. The native runner executes KiCad ERC/DRC and Gerber/drill exports. Report unsupported circuit correspondence or layout capabilities rather than inventing success.
limitations: Requires independent design-rule, netlist and circuit-correspondence checks before release.
